svg.title: Spectrum Colors Arranged by Chance
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid colours. Observed 38×38 source grid sampled at cell centres; colours assigned to a vivid family palette. No chance pattern generated.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/spectrum-colors-arranged-by-chance/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
